english: there is nothing new under the sun

terms.latin: Nūllum est jam dictum quod nōn dictum sit prius.
terms.comment: Literally “nothing is said now that has not been said before”.

terms.latin: Nīl dictum quod nōn prius dictum.
terms.comment: We have found no ancient source for it in Lewis & Short or the loci collections.

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, cited by printed page; each phrase checked against the searchable text of the book.
Quotations from the Latinitas loci collections, checked against the editions named there.
